6. REVIEW-MODE BEHAVIOUR — where he reviews others' PRs/code: what he checks, in what order, what he rejects, how he phrases feedback. Verbatim.

Output a structured report with these six numbered sections. Every finding must have: verbatim quote, session title, turn number, area tag (where applicable). If a section is empty, say so explicitly. Do NOT write any files. Return findings as your final message. Be exhaustive on section 1.
